segment_contamination_dimensions: Large-span non-decorative tensile structures (auditorium covers, walkway sheds, car parking canopies) targeting industrial/institutional buyers — protected against by sibling 'Auditorium Tensile Structure' (ID 135861) and 'Tensile Structures' (ID 50762); names implying stadium-scale or purely functional industrial canopy use are discarded.

Generic modular tensile structures without gazebo-specific decorative-functional character — protected against by sibling 'Modular Tensile Structure' (ID 42328); names that are semantically equivalent to 'Modular Tensile Structure' alone (without gazebo qualifier) are discarded.

Prefabricated or permanent enclosed buildings (steel, modular, portable) targeting construction/industrial buyers — siblings such as 'Prefabricated Buildings' (ID 35589), 'Modular Buildings' (ID 33188), and 'Prefabricated Steel Buildings' (ID 20474) attract fundamentally different buyer personas; names implying enclosed permanent construction are discarded.

Agricultural or horticultural membrane structures (greenhouses, polyhouses) targeting farming buyers — siblings 'Greenhouse' (ID 29816), 'Polyhouse' (ID 149713), and 'Agricultural Greenhouses' (ID 21344) attract agri-sector buyers incompatible with hospitality/leisure gazebo buyers; names implying crop protection or growing-environment use are discarded.
